name: harness-memory
description: Shared agent memory via HTTP MCP — recall, save facts, wiki pages, and inbox against a running memoryd. No local Node server.

MEMORY_URL.description: Base URL of memoryd (no trailing slash). Local brew default is http://127.0.0.1:8741; set this for compose/helm/remote.

MEMORY_TOKEN.description: Per-harness token from `memory token create --harness claude` (or grok). Do not use the admin token.
